enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +18: Passive: +18 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Potency +68: Passive: +68 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Nullification +102: Passive: +102 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Spell Penetration III: Passive: +3 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Lesser Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by one.
Necromancy Focus III: +3 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
